perception.invariant: The rendering profile changes neither decision-model perception nor vehicle dynamics.

calibration.selectionMethod: Fixed-pose visual composition against the physical two-box frame.

rcIndoor.rationale: The archived calibration script exposes 62.2 by 48.8 degrees only as a default FOV prior. At the matched scenario pose that narrow pinhole crop pushed both boxes against the frame edges. An 86 degree horizontal pinhole equivalent preserves the physical frame's two-box composition while lens distortion remains deferred.
